def widened_hostnames(hostname):
    """Generate parent-domain variants of a hostname by successively removing the leftmost label.
    
    Args:
        hostname: The hostname to process
    
    Returns:
        An Iterable[str] of the widening sequence
    
    Edge cases:
    - Single label: ["foobarbaz"]
    - Empty string: []
    - "example.com": ["example.com", "com"]
    .c: [".c", "c"]
